The Practice of Hadhrat Qais bin Sa'd (RA)

Hadhrat Jaabir bin Abdullaah (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once dispatched an army under the command of Hadhrat Qais bin Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA). When the army suffered hunger, he slaughtered nine riding animals (for them to eat). After the expedition returned and the incident was mentioned to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, "Verily generosity is the hallmark of that family."[^2]

Another narration from Hadhrat Raafi bin Khudayj (RA) states that Hadhrat Abu Ubaydah (RA) and Hadhrat Umar (RA) both approached Hadhrat Qais bin Sa'd (RA) and implored him not to slaughter any more camels (because it would deprive the army of their transport). However, he still went ahead to do so. When the news reached Rasulullaah ﷺ, he said, "He is after all from the house of generosity." This occurred during the "Expedition of Leaves" (when the Sahabah (RA) were forced to eat leaves because they had no food).[^3]
A Giant Fish comes to the Shore for the Mujaahideen

Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) narrates, "Qais bin Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA) once passed by us during the time of Rasulullaah ﷺ when we were suffering severe hunger. He slaughtered seven camels for us (and we continued on our expedition). When we set up camp along the shore, we found a giant fish lying there. We lived off it for three days and took along with us as much of its fat we could store in our water bags and satchels. We then travelled back until we came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and informed him of what had transpired." The Sahabah (RA) (who were part of the expedition) said, "If we had assurance that the fish would not rot before we reached Rasulullaah ﷺ, we would have loved to take some back for him."[^4]
